scope: Individual goal settings UI generated design preview
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One high-fidelity iPhone UI design preview for the individual goal configuration page inside 粥记.
Primary request: Create the "目标设置" screen opened from one specific goal's detail page. This is the editable settings form for the goal "多读书". It is NOT the goals overview, and NOT the task/progress detail screen. Show only the configuration of this one goal.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing generated goal detail screen and exact visual-system reference. Image 2 is the approved new-task form style reference. Image 3 is the original brand/illustration reference. Match their warm ivory paper, dark olive handwritten Chinese typography, thin sandy outlines, flat silkscreen ink and identical durian mascot.
Composition: Single edge-to-edge portrait iPhone screen, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio, no device frame, no external poster, no collage. Status bar 9:41 and black cellular/Wi-Fi/battery symbols. Top-left olive back chevron. Dark home indicator at bottom. No keyboard visible.
Style/medium: Authentic vintage silkscreen poster style combined with hand-drawn FLAT illustration: fibrous cream paper, dry ink grain and irregular tiny white speckles inside ink areas, slightly uneven dark warm-brown outlines. Restrained forest/moss/olive green, buttery yellow, muted terracotta, warm brown. Chinese fixed labels use natural rounded Xiaolai-like handwritten strokes. Clean legible text, no grain interfering with letters. No 3D, gloss, gradient, airbrushed shadows or dark mode.
Layout and exact content:
1. Large upper-left title exactly "目标设置". Small friendly durian mascot upper-right writing in an open cream notebook, much smaller than the form. Same squat green spiky durian shell, short brown stem, broad warm yellow face, black dot eyes and smiling mouth, orange cheeks, tiny cream hands and brown feet as the references. No large scenic background.
2. Compact ivory rounded preview card under the header: forest green open-book icon on the left, name "多读书", with the smaller muted text "让每个目标一眼可认出" below it. This previews the selected icon and editable name, with generous padding and a thin warm-sand border.
3. Section label "名称", then a single ivory inset rounded text field containing "多读书". Natural clean dark typed text. This is the only name field; no duplicate editable fields. No cursor needed.
4. Section label "图标", followed by a tidy 4-column grid of 10 selectable rounded icon tiles, aligned and sized equally. Four icons in row one, four in row two, and two left-aligned in row three. Every tile has a hand-printed pictogram above its small Chinese label. Exact order and labels:
row 1: small target with sparkle "自动匹配"; simple bullseye target "目标"; open book "阅读"; graduation cap "学习".
row 2: briefcase "工作"; smartphone "数字产品"; dumbbell "运动"; heart "健康".
row 3: painter's palette "创作"; sprout with two leaves "成长".
The "阅读" tile in row one, column three is selected: a subtle pale olive fill, olive outline, and a tiny olive check badge in the upper-right. The other nine tiles have cream fill and thin sandy outlines. "自动匹配" is not selected. Use the same earthy ink palette and handmade icon language as the references, no glossy emoji.
5. Near the bottom, one full-width muted-terracotta rounded rectangular action button with visible white ink grain, ivory text exactly "保存设置". Insets align with the form. It is comfortably above the home indicator, large and easy to read. Leave calm cream breathing room between the grid and button.
This is a focused child settings page with one back arrow and one save button. Do not show a bottom four-tab navigation on this form. Only the two existing configurable properties, goal name and built-in icon, are shown. Do not include task rows, checklists, goal percentages, progress bars, goals list, add-task field, multiple goals, description, deadlines, priorities, reminders, colors, weights, KPI, deletion button, backup, account settings or extra slogans. Accurate Chinese rendering with no extra words. Render one finished individual-goal settings screen.
visual_review: Goal settings heading, name preview, editable name, all 10 built-in icon choices, selected reading icon and save button are legible. Cream paper, printed mascot, palette and typography match previous previews.
